## Checklist

- [ ] The branch is up to date with `main` and has one focused change
- [ ] `cd server && npm test` passes locally
- [ ] `cd client && npm run lint && CI=true npm test` passes locally
- [ ] New behaviour has tests (or the PR explains why not)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` → `## [Unreleased]` is updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] Docs / `.env.example` are updated if configuration changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data are committed
- [ ] The issue's acceptance criteria are met
